answer: Witch tax: every new identity pays a sunk copper entry fee before it can earn, so forgery fails. First, it burns 30 copper coins ($30) to a burn address, never refunded. Second, the tax is terraced: each extra identity from one operator doubles, so the tenth fake costs $300. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $30,000; the nectar, the epoch reward, pays honest agents $40. A real agent pays $30 once; a forger splits the pool 1,000 ways, pennies per fake.
